Paragraph: "This gallinule bird happily calling in the forest brooks is making me awesome with its calls, as the Love-god has already made me awestricken...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hearing the happy calling of a gallinule bird near forest brooks intensifies Rama's emotional longing.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama expresses how love and nature combine to deeply disturb his emotional equilibrium.
Outcome/Resolution: He voices his inner sense of distress to his brother.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Manmadha-Avishta (State of being overwhelmed by intense feelings of affection/longing)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The happy calls of nature highlight the absence of the divine divine consort, intensifying Rama's profound sense of longing.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Heightened emotional sensitivity where simple natural sounds elicit strong emotional responses due to pre-existing grief.
